title: Data Cleaning reference solution
answer: SELECT LOWER(TRIM(email)) AS normalized_email, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count FROM customers GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(email)) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY duplicate_count DESC;
